column3: ## References are available in the public API

column1: Depends on Article References : Article References : Preparation

column3: Request the article from the API, using the article id noted in the Preparation test, by going to /api/articles/{article_id}

column4: The JSON response contains a "bibjson.reference" array with the 4 references, as strings, in the order they were uploaded

column3: Search for the article via the API search endpoint, e.g. /api/search/articles/bibjson.title:%22References!%22

column4: The article in the results contains the same "bibjson.reference" array
